findings.title: Design spec §7.5 step 4 still documents push_pr as `gh pr create --fill`
findings.detail: The spec reads: "`pr`: `run push_pr` — the session runs `git push -u origin <branch>` and `gh pr create --base <base> --fill`, then `done --step push_pr --url <pr-url>`". This wave replaces `--fill` with a generated `--title '<title>' --body-file <path>` (internal/finish/pr.go, internal/brief/templates/run-push_pr.md, internal/decide/questions.go's `pr` option) specifically so no committed tree describes inputs that don't exist — but this authoritative design doc was left unchanged and now contradicts the exact behaviour it is meant to describe. Unaddressed since attempt 2's review.

findings.title: §4.2's bundle file listing omits the new finish/pr.md artifact
findings.detail: The `### 4.2 Files` tree enumerates every file a bundle can contain — `finish/verify.json`, `finish/goals.json`, `finish/retro-inputs.json`, etc. — but this wave adds `finish/pr.md` (finish.PRPath/WritePR, written by preparePushPR on every push_pr op) and the tree was not updated to list it. Unaddressed since attempt 2's review.

findings.title: Claude Code op-table prompt still hardcodes `gh pr create --fill` for push_pr
findings.detail: The `run` row's push_pr parenthetical still reads "...then `git push -u origin <branch>` and `gh pr create --base <base> --fill`", which no longer matches the op's actual rendered instructions (title/body-file generated from the run's own artifacts, never `--fill`). This is the live prompt loaded for the `/takt` command and should describe the new command. Unaddressed since attempt 2's review.

findings.title: Copilot host skill still hardcodes `gh pr create --fill` for push_pr
findings.detail: Same stale parenthetical as commands/takt.md line 31 — "`gh pr create --base <base> --fill`" — no longer matches the op's rendered instructions (`--title`/`--body-file`). Both host prompts are meant to carry the same op table and are now stale together. Unaddressed since attempt 2's review.
